name: Propagation
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God established the principle of propagation according to distinct kinds, commanding the earth to bring forth plants and living creatures each after their own kind. This divine ordinance is evident in the creation account where plants, sea creatures, birds, and land animals were created to reproduce within their species, ensuring order and continuity in creation. Moreover, God’s blessing to be fruitful and multiply underscores His purposeful design for life to expand within established boundaries, reflecting His sovereign wisdom and goodness.
